name: Furumiya Elis
source:
The day after Tomo went to the old school, he comes upon a transfer student.

Elis is a transfer student. Half-japanese and half-british, she talks to everyone with polite voice. Becomes popular among the students right after her arrival.

Contrary to her mysterious appearance, she tends to trip when she runs and is a glutton that has a particular weakness to sweets.

"...Yes, the sound is from... from my belly."
